name: Solar Water Pumping System
benefit: - **Subsidy Amount:** A 75% subsidy is provided on the cost of solar water pumps.
_eligibility_text: 1. Any Haryana Resident family with Pariwar Pahichan Patra (PPP). 1. Farmers of Haryana with no electric agricultural connection in his/her name. 1. Water User Associations, Gaushalas, and community/cluster-based irrigation systems. 1. The beneficiaries who have not been covered under the solar pump scheme in past.
